head: da4c99fa1c781b6bd6a440348c147287f0cdb603
scope: Read-only diff, caller, daemon lock, dependency source, official saved API schema, and existing run artifact audit.
independence: This pass consumed existing dogfood and cleanup evidence and is corroboration, not a blind or cross-family review. No source or shared report changes.

findings.title: Bound the new create request and response read
findings.claim: The new HTTP create request and full response read have no request deadline. A peer that accepts a connection but never answers holds the daemon state lock; close and idle cleanup cannot progress.
source_evidence: reqwest 0.12.28 async_impl/client.rs defaults connect_timeout=None, read_timeout=None, timeout=None; timeout docs state default no timeout
cli/src/native/daemon.rs:553-554 holds state.lock while awaiting execute_command
cli/src/native/actions.rs:3527 and 4469 provider calls await without an outer timeout
findings.empirical_evidence: Existing dogfood.json: proxy_reached=true; open exceeded 36 seconds; concurrent close exceeded 5 seconds; daemon still alive despite configured 1000ms idle timeout. Proxy release allowed close.
findings.limit: Measurements were produced by the existing coordinator artifact, not rerun by this pass.

findings.title: Do not discard the session when the V4 stop fails
findings.claim: The PR makes Browser Use return a managed ProviderSession and activates the stop path, but stop errors and non-success HTTP statuses are ignored. close_active_provider_session takes the session before awaiting, so close reports success and a second close has no session ID to retry.
source_evidence: cli/src/native/providers.rs:142-151 ignores send result and status
findings.empirical_evidence: Successful section of existing cleanup-probe.log: FIRST_CLOSE success=true, RETAINED_SESSION=false, SECOND_CLOSE success=true, STOP_TRANSPORT_ATTEMPTS=1 after proxy returns 502.
findings.limit: Scratch probe injects retained state and transport failure, not a live cloud session; log contains an unrelated failed compile tail and should be regenerated cleanly before final receipt.

verification_gaps: Existing tests.log stopped at timed_out_plugin_is_killed with no final test-result summary at inspection; full-suite success cannot be asserted from it.
No passing Test Strength or Resilience receipt in existing manifest.

The saved API schema permits absent/null cdpUrl. The parser loses an otherwise valid id on that branch; active-create reachability is not proven, so this is an unverified cleanup gap rather than an additional confirmed finding.

concurrency_observations.note: Concurrent coordinator work appears active; final identity should be refreshed after its build/setup.
